title: Qui répond des mathématiques produites par machine ? — public reproducibility package
description: Public redacted reproducibility package accompanying scientific manuscript version 1.1.1 prepared on 30 September 2026. Frozen pilot dataset v1.1.2 contains 21 events, 13 sources and 7 claims. It provides structural validation, four mutation tests, descriptive analysis, prior-art positioning, a prospective control design and a bounded collaboration agenda. Private sources and autonomous mathematical certificate packages are not redistributed. Structural validation does not prove the mathematical statements or establish AI reliability.
